name: Feather Fall

casting_time.trigger: you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls

components.m: a small feather or piece of down

summary: Reaction: up to five falling creatures drop only 60 feet per round and take no falling damage.
text: Reaction, taken when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls. Choose up to five falling creatures within range. For 1 minute each one falls at only 60 feet per round. A creature that lands before the spell ends takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for it.
